about.title: Empowering Mental Wellness Through Community
about.description: Addis Tesfa (meaning "New Hope" in Amharic) was founded in 2024 with a simple mission: to create a safe, anonymous space where anyone can share their mental health journey without fear of judgment.
about.mission: To make mental health support accessible, affordable, and stigma-free for everyone.
about.vision: A world where no one faces mental health challenges alone, and support is always one click away.
about.values: Compassion, privacy, inclusivity, and evidence-based support guide everything we do.

contact.title: We are Here to Help
contact.subtitle: Have questions or need support? Reach out to our team. We are committed to making your experience safe and supportive.
